problem_summary: 10 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in HBR Layout between May 2019 and June 2022, spanning 3 calendar year(s). 40% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened). 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after initially being resolved.

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 89 pothole complaints.
41 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹20.9 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (exact_name join).

hypotheses: HYPOTHESIS (unverified): 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after being marked resolved. This may indicate short-term or superficial repairs that did not address the underlying problem.
agency_attribution_note: 10 of 10 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.45). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.40, complaint_volume=0.33.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='HBR Layout' matched to datameet243=96 via exact_name (overlap_confidence=0.671).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for HBR Layout for the period 2019–2022.
Request inspection records for the 41 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Investigate the 1 re-opened complaint(s) to determine whether patchwork repairs were applied and failed.
